verdict.rationale: AgentMail's API reference documents an official Python SDK, and the homepage shows a JavaScript client call (`client.inboxes.create()`). A community user also praised the dashboard's SDK-example popovers, so the core story is delivered. missing for 10: an explicit list of supported SDK languages, a named TypeScript/Node package, SDK install/versioning docs, and hands-on reports of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Use our Python SDK for seamless integration with your Python applications.
Praise for the dashboard's popovers showing SDK examples
